title: Identity and unit numbers
goal: Представиться и назвать компанию, номера тягача и прицепа
phrases: My name is Alex Example.
I drive for Training Carrier.
The tractor is T-204.
The trailer is TR-518.

title: Spelling on the phone
titleRu: Диктовка букв и номера по телефону
phrases: A as in Alpha.
Please confirm the last letter.
The code is T-R-five-one-eight.

title: Dates, times and appointments
phrases: My appointment is at 9:30 a.m.
I arrived at 8:55.
The delivery is tomorrow morning.

title: Load and reference numbers
phrases: The load number is zero-zero-zero-five-one-eight.
Please repeat the last four digits.
The BOL number is 2048.

title: Origin and destination
phrases: I picked up in Columbus, Ohio.
I am delivering in Nashville, Tennessee.
My final destination is Atlanta, Georgia.

title: Cargo, pieces, weight and seal
titleRu: Груз, количество мест, вес и пломба
phrases: I am hauling packaged food.
The load has 22 pallets.
The seal number is 000845.

title: Gate, yard and dock directions
goal: Понять движение по территории и погрузочной площадке
phrases: Proceed to gate two.
Park in row C.
Back into dock door 18.

title: Duty status and available hours
phrases: I am on duty, not driving.
I have four hours and eighteen minutes left.
My logs are current and certified.

title: Defect report
goal: Описать деталь, неисправность, место и серьезность
phrases: The right rear marker light is out.
I found an air leak near the trailer axle.
I will not move until it is checked.

title: Delay and updated ETA
phrases: Traffic is stopped because of a crash.
My new ETA is 4:30 p.m.
I will update you after the detour.

title: Clarification and repair phrases
phrases: Could you repeat that more slowly?
Could you rephrase the question?
May I repeat the instruction to confirm it?

title: Driver and vehicle documents
phrases: Here is my CDL.
Here is the tractor registration.
The periodic inspection report is on the vehicle.

title: Level I and Level II commands
titleRu: Команды при проверке уровней I и II
phrases: The parking brake is set.
The headlights are on.
I am applying and holding the service brake.

title: Level III representative questions
titleRu: Учебные вопросы для проверки уровня III
goal: Отвечать о документах, рейсе и HOS
phrases: I drive for Training Carrier.
I picked up in Columbus.
I have four hours and eighteen minutes left.

title: State trooper traffic stop
phrases: May I reach for the document folder?
I am delivering to Nashville.
I will stay in the vehicle.

title: Full ELP rehearsal
goal: Пройти интервью только на английском и распознавание знаков
phrases: I am hauling packaged food.
The sign means trucks must use this exit.
Would you like me to show or transfer the records?

title: Pickup, trailer and ratings
titleRu: Пикап, прицеп и допустимые весовые характеристики
goal: Описать состав Hotshot и назвать допустимые характеристики
phrases: I operate a heavy-duty pickup with a gooseneck trailer.
The pickup and trailer ratings are on the certification labels.
I checked the combination and axle weights.
The trailer brake controller is working.

title: Loading a vehicle
goal: Управлять погрузкой исправного и неисправного автомобиля
phrases: Does the vehicle start and move under its own power?
Keep the steering unlocked while I guide the vehicle.
Center the vehicle on the trailer.
Stay clear of the tensioned winch line.

title: Securing transported vehicles
phrases: Each vehicle is secured at the front and rear.
The tiedowns are attached to rated points.
The wheel straps are centered and tight.
I rechecked every tiedown after departure.

title: Pickup and delivery condition
goal: Сверить VIN, отметить повреждения и получить подпись
phrases: I need to verify the VIN before loading.
This scratch is listed as existing damage.
Please inspect the vehicle before signing.
The receiver reported no new damage.

title: Enclosed car trailer
titleRu: Закрытый автовоз: погрузка, обзор и двери
goal: Погрузить автомобиль при ограниченном обзоре и проверить двери
phrases: Check the ramp angle and interior clearance.
Use a spotter because side clearance is limited.
The vehicle is secured inside the enclosed trailer.
The rear ramp and side doors are locked for travel.
